description: The egress gate, which the Integration Sidecar opens on hitl_contact_<audience> when the rule that decides a call ends in an audience (architecture §3.16.4).

since.description: When the Logic Container requested the call.

trace_id.description: The trace the call is requested under.

task_id.description: The task the call runs on.

cost.description: The trace's accumulated cost, in cost_unit (architecture §3.15.1).

details.description: The call and what sent it to the audience (architecture §3.16.4).

entry.description: The egress_registry key of the entry that gated the call.

rule.description: The rule that sent the call to the audience, as the parser that evaluated it prints it.

config_version.description: The version whose egress_registry was read.

fields.description: The fields the interface declares for the operation, as validated.

body_size.description: The size of the call's body, in bytes; only with a body.

body_digest.description: The digest of the call's body; only with a body.

digest.description: The digest of the request: the entry, its target, the operation, the fields and the body's digest, in the form of implementation §8.1.

topic.description: The topic of the node that requests the call.

node_id.description: The node that requests the call.
